cleanup_query: match $action isa Action, has action_name "{key}"; delete $action isa Action;

queries.query: insert $action isa Action, has action_name "{key}", has action_duration {cycle_float}, has result true;
match $action isa Action, has action_name "{key}", has action_duration $duration; delete $action has $duration; insert $action has action_duration {cycle_plus_one_float};
match $action isa Action, has action_name "{key}"; delete $action isa Action;
